levels.name: Repeat!
levels.hint: Put Forward inside Repeat, then tap the number until it says 7.

levels.name: Two lines
levels.hint: Use a Repeat for each straight line, with a turn between.

levels.name: Staircase
levels.hint: One step, turn, one step, turn. Put that pattern in a Repeat.

levels.name: Three lines
alt: F F R r3(F) L r5(F)
levels.hint: Count each straight line. A Repeat for each one saves blocks.

levels.name: Big steps
levels.hint: Two steps, turn left, one step, turn right. Then again!

levels.name: Loop in a loop
levels.hint: A Repeat can go inside another Repeat. Try one for each side.

levels.name: Rectangle
levels.hint: A long side, a turn, a short side, a turn. Do that twice.

levels.name: Comb
levels.sol: r4(r2(L F F F L) F F)
alt: r4(L r3(F) R R r3(F) L r2(F))
levels.hint: Turn left, go up, turn left: twice takes you up and back down.

levels.name: Square swirl
levels.hint: Three long sides, then two short ones. One Repeat for each kind!

levels.name: S for snake
levels.hint: The top of the S turns one way. The bottom turns the other way.

levels.name: Four windows
levels.hint: Go round one window pane, then turn. How many panes are there?

levels.name: Compass points
alt: r4(F F R R F F L)
levels.hint: Out to a gem and back again. Is that the same few blocks twice?

levels.name: Diamond stairs
levels.hint: Each side of the diamond is a staircase. Then the robot turns.

levels.name: Cut corners
levels.sol: r4(r3(F) R F L F R)
levels.hint: A long side, then a little step round the corner. Spot it four times!

levels.name: Wonky box
levels.sol: r2(r3(F) R r3(F R F L) R)
levels.hint: Two sides are straight and two are stairs. Do one of each, twice.

levels.name: Hilltop
levels.sol: r2(r3(L F R F) R F)
alt: r3(L F R F) r3(R F L F)
levels.hint: Look again: is the way down the same stairs as the way up, turned?

levels.name: Boulder hop
levels.sol: r2(L r2(F R F) L F F)
alt: r2(L F R F F R F L F F)
levels.hint: Up, over and down a rock: can you spot a little piece that comes twice?

levels.name: Plus pond
alt: r4(r2(F F R) F F L)
levels.hint: Each arm of the pond is three sides of a little square.

levels.name: Tree branches
levels.sol: r3(L r2(F L L F) R F F)
levels.hint: Out to a gem and back, then the same on the other side. Then climb!

levels.name: Big window
levels.hint: A loop in a loop in a loop! Start with one side of one pane.
